notes: The single table is sufficient for one product record per SKU with one standard price-list entry; price effective_from/effective_to are not supplied and should remain null.
SKU values were profiled as integers but visibly contain leading zeros in the distinct values (e.g. 00470001); the mapping must cast SKU to text and preserve the original eight-character form.
Currency EUR and tax rate 5% are explicit row-level source values. No FX conversion or VAT-rate inference is permitted.
'Tax included' = No establishes that 'Net price' is VAT-exclusive; /prices/*/vat_included should be false and the amount should not be grossed up.
The sales unit 'BT' is unresolved. Confirm whether BT means BOTTLE (the nearest target enum) or another canonical unit before publishing /unit/sell_unit; otherwise retain the source code for review.

tables.reason: One row per unique SKU (12/12 distinct) with product name, currency, sales unit and a single standard price. It is a product-master export with embedded pricing rather than a standalone price, inventory or promotion table.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header is SKU; every row is distinct (12/12). Values such as 00470001 are zero-padded even though the profiler inferred numeric, so they must be read as text and leading zeros preserved.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header and one distinct product name per SKU; directly satisfies the required product name field.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Every row explicitly states EUR; this is a source-provided ISO currency and must not be converted or replaced by a local default.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header explicitly denotes the sales unit and every row is 'BT'. 'BT' is not one of the target enum_hint values, and the file does not define whether it means BOTTLE, BATCH or another unit; mapping is provisional pending clarification.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header 'Price list' and the single explicit value 'standard' identify the price-list name required for the price collection item.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header 'Net price' and continuous decimal values 1234.56–1356.77 indicate the price amount. Since 'Tax included' is explicitly 'No', this amount is VAT-exclusive and should not be VAT-adjusted.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: All rows explicitly say 'No', which parses to false for the required vat_included field: the net price does not include VAT.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: All rows explicitly state 5%; this is the source-provided tax rate and should be parsed as a percentage to 0.05, not inferred from country or retail convention.

clarifications.why: 'BT' is not one of the target unit values (PCS, PACK, BOX, CARTON, SET, BOTTLE, ...) and the file nowhere defines it. Units must not be inferred from country, brand or retail convention, so the code is currently retained as-is rather than guessed.

changes_from_draft: /sku now cast to string after trim (draft left the raw numeric-profiled column); leading zeros '00470001' preserved, no strip_leading_zeros and no numeric cast.
/prices/*/price_list now read from the 'Price list' source column ('standard') instead of a hard-coded constant, so the value is evidenced by the file.
/prices/*/vat_included now parsed from the explicit 'Tax included' column ('No' → false) with a false fallback, instead of an unevidenced constant.
Added /prices/*/vat_rate mapped from the explicit 'Tax rate' column ('5%' → 0.05, percent-to-fraction); the schema default 0.07 was not applied because the source states a rate.
/prices/*/amount left VAT-exclusive and unadjusted; no vat_adjust applied because the source declares 'Tax included = No' for the stated net price.
/currency kept as a source read (EUR on every row) with no FX conversion and no THB default substitution.

/unit/sell_unit changed from a plain unit_normalize to unit_normalize-with-raw-fallback: 'BT' is not resolvable from the file, so the code is preserved and an operator clarification was raised (confidence 0.55).
Added record dedupe on /sku and price dedupe key /price_list (identity keys are /price_list + /effective_from; effective_from is not supplied so it is left null).
/prices/*/effective_from and /prices/*/effective_to left unmapped — the export contains no validity dates.

/status, /barcode, /brand, /category, /description, /unit/pack_size, /inventory and /promotions left unmapped: no corresponding source columns exist and none were invented (status falls back to the schema default 'active').
Unmatched source column 'Tax rate' is no longer orphaned — it now feeds /prices/*/vat_rate.
